passages.title: 2008年上海秋考英语 · 阅读理解 C · Teenagers and Money
passages.page: 第7页 · 阅读理解 C（72—75题）

sentences.sentence: A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds found that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money.

targets.s: A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds
targets.o: that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money.

sentences.main: A study found that most of them are ignorant.
sentences.analysis:
【主句主干】主句主语中心 A study（完整主语 A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds），谓语 found；found 后接 that 引导的完整宾语从句 that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money。
【主句定语】involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds 为现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 study；其中 from all social backgrounds 修饰 teenagers，说明其社会背景。
【宾语从句内部】that 为连接词；most of them 为从句主语；are 为系动词；ignorant 为形容词表语，构成主系表；when it comes to money 为习惯表达，作方面/话题状语，限定从句内部的 ignorant。
【主句状语】主句本身没有独立的状语，不能把宾语从句中的 when it comes to money 误标成修饰 found 的主句状语。
【判题口径】主句主语选 A study 或完整主语均正确；宾语选 that most of them are ignorant 或完整宾语从句均正确。但分析完整结构时应补充后置定语和从句内部的状语。
sentences.meaning: 一项涉及来自各种社会背景的8500名青少年的研究发现，大多数人在涉及金钱问题时缺乏相关知识。
distractors: 一项针对8500名青少年的研究发现，无论家庭背景如何，大多数人都熟悉各种金钱问题。
这项研究只调查了来自富裕家庭的8500名青少年，发现他们普遍缺乏理财知识。
一项涉及8500名成年人的研究发现，青少年对金钱问题的了解普遍超过成年人。
deepNotes: 主句完整主语范围含 involving ... 的后置定语，但核心主语 A study 可以独立识别。主语中心与完整主语都算对。
involving 为现在分词而非主句谓语；不能因它位于 study 后便误认成另一个主句动作。
found 后面的 that 引导宾语从句；从句内 most of them are ignorant 是主系表，不是主句又出现了一套主谓。
when it comes to money 是从句内部的方面/话题状语，不是主句的时间状语；主句没有单独的状语。
完整宾语从句包含尾部的 when it comes to money；选 that most of them are ignorant 可用于识别其核心结构。

roleExplanations.s: 主句完整主语是 A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds；中心主语是 A study。后面 involving ... 为修饰 study 的现在分词后置定语，两种主语范围都接受。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是 found（发现）；不要误将 involving 或宾语从句里的 are / comes 当成主句谓语。
roleExplanations.o: 主句宾语是 that 引导的完整宾语从句 that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money；其核心 most of them are ignorant 为主系表结构，when it comes to money 是从句内部的方面状语。

grammarSupplements.text: involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds
grammarSupplements.explanation: 整个 involving ... 是现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰主语中心词 study；其中 from all social backgrounds 修饰 teenagers。主句谓语只有 found。

grammarSupplements.kind: 宾语从句内部·方面状语
grammarSupplements.text: when it comes to money.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 这是宾语从句内部的方面/话题状语，意思是‘谈到金钱时’。宾语从句的主干是 most of them（主语）+ are（系动词）+ ignorant（表语）；它不是主句 found 的状语。

o: that most of them are ignorant

studyUnits.question: 找出修饰 study、说明研究对象的完整后置定语。
studyUnits.text: involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds
studyUnits.explanation: 整个 involving ... 是现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰主语中心词 study；其中 from all social backgrounds 修饰 teenagers。主句谓语只有 found。

studyUnits.kind: 宾语从句内部·方面状语
studyUnits.question: 宾语从句最后哪一部分限定‘缺乏知识’所涉及的话题？
studyUnits.text: when it comes to money.
studyUnits.explanation: 这是宾语从句内部的方面/话题状语，意思是‘谈到金钱时’。宾语从句的主干是 most of them（主语）+ are（系动词）+ ignorant（表语）；它不是主句 found 的状语。

sentences.sentence: The findings, the first in a series of reports from NatWest that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money, are particularly worrying as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before.

targets.m: that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money,
targets.x: as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before.

sentences.analysis:
【主句】The findings 是主语，are 为系动词，particularly worrying 为形容词性表语，构成主系表。
【主语补充】the first in a series of reports ... money 是 findings 的同位语，说明这是系列报告中的第一份。that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money 修饰 NatWest，has started 为该定语从句谓语。
【原因状语从句】as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before 是修饰主句‘令人担忧’的原因从句；内部 this generation of young people 为主语，is likely 为系表结构，to be burdened ... 为不定式补充，其核心 to be burdened 是被动结构；than any before 省略重复名词，比较前代年轻人的债务。
【界限】主句没有宾语；研究项目属于定语从句，不能算成 are 的宾语。
sentences.meaning: 这些研究结果属于NatWest五年研究的一系列报告中的首份成果，格外令人担忧，因为这一代年轻人可能承受比以往任何一代更沉重的债务。
distractors: NatWest为期五年的研究已经完成，结果表明这一代年轻人的债务负担将比过去更轻。
这些令人担忧的结果来自NatWest研究的最后一份报告，因为年轻人的债务问题已经得到解决。
NatWest的首份报告认为，尽管年轻人面临债务，但他们的负债水平与前几代完全相同。
deepNotes: 【主句】The findings 是主语，are 为系动词，particularly worrying 为形容词性表语，构成主系表。
【主语补充】the first in a series of reports ... money 是 findings 的同位语，说明这是系列报告中的第一份。that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money 修饰 NatWest，has started 为该定语从句谓语。

【原因状语从句】as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before 是修饰主句‘令人担忧’的原因从句；内部 this generation of young people 为主语，is likely 为系表结构，to be burdened ... 为不定式补充，其核心 to be burdened 是被动结构；than any before 省略重复名词，比较前代年轻人的债务。
【界限】主句没有宾语；研究项目属于定语从句，不能算成 are 的宾语。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语 The findings（这些研究结果）；紧随其后的 the first ... 是同位语，不是另一个主句主语。
roleExplanations.v: are 是主句系动词，particularly worrying 为表语；不是‘are + 宾语’。
roleExplanations.m: that has started ... 修饰 NatWest，that 为该定语从句主语、has started 为谓语、a five-year research project 为宾语。
roleExplanations.x: as 引导原因状语从句，交代为何这些结果格外令人担忧。

grammarSupplements.text: the first in a series of reports from NatWest that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money,
grammarSupplements.explanation: 这段是 findings 的同位语；其中 from NatWest 说明报告来源，that has started ... 为修饰 NatWest 的定语从句（that 作主语，has started 作谓语）。

grammarSupplements.text: particularly worrying
grammarSupplements.explanation: 主句 The findings are particularly worrying 是主系表结构。are 是系动词，particularly worrying 是表语；下文 as 原因状语从句解释为何令人担忧。

grammarSupplements.kind: 原因从句内的重要补足结构
grammarSupplements.text: to be burdened with greater debts than any before.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 这段不定式补充 likely 的内容。to be burdened 是被动结构；greater ... than any before 表示相较以往任何一代债务更重。从句主语是 this generation of young people，is likely 表示‘很可能’。

studyUnits.question: 哪个插入成分解释 The findings 是哪一份报告？
studyUnits.text: the first in a series of reports from NatWest that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money,
studyUnits.explanation: 这段是 findings 的同位语；其中 from NatWest 说明报告来源，that has started ... 为修饰 NatWest 的定语从句（that 作主语，has started 作谓语）。

studyUnits.question: 找出说明这些调查结果‘格外令人担忧’的完整表语。
studyUnits.text: particularly worrying
studyUnits.explanation: 主句 The findings are particularly worrying 是主系表结构。are 是系动词，particularly worrying 是表语；下文 as 原因状语从句解释为何令人担忧。

studyUnits.kind: 原因从句内的重要补足结构
studyUnits.question: 原因状语从句中，哪一段说明这一代人可能背负怎样的债务？
studyUnits.text: to be burdened with greater debts than any before.
studyUnits.explanation: 这段不定式补充 likely 的内容。to be burdened 是被动结构；greater ... than any before 表示相较以往任何一代债务更重。从句主语是 this generation of young people，is likely 表示‘很可能’。

sentences.sentence: University tuition fees (学费) are currently capped at £3,000 annually, but this will be reviewed next year and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.
sentences.main: University tuition fees are currently capped; this will be reviewed; and the Government is under enormous pressure.
sentences.analysis:
【并列分句①】University tuition fees (学费) 是主语，are currently capped 为被动谓语，at £3,000 表示学费上限，annually 表示每年。
【并列分句②】but this will be reviewed next year：this 是主语，指前文收费上限，will be reviewed 为被动谓语，next year 为时间状语。
【并列分句③】and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling：the Government 为主语，is 为系动词，under enormous pressure 为介词短语作表语；to raise the ceiling 为不定式后置修饰 pressure，交代压力要求的行动；the ceiling 指费用上限。
【易错点】三组主语分别是 tuition fees / this / the Government。but 和 and 连接的是三个分句，不能误判为相同主语的并列谓语；这里没有主句的直接宾语。
sentences.meaning: 大学学费目前的年度上限是3000英镑，不过这项限制将于明年重新审议，而政府正面临要求提高上限的巨大压力。
distractors: 英国大学学费目前每年最低为3000英镑，政府计划在明年取消这一最低收费标准。
大学学费的年度上限已经提高到3000英镑以上，政府正面临要求降低学费的巨大压力。
大学学费的上限目前是每年3000英镑，政府已经决定明年不再审议或调整这一限制。
deepNotes: 【并列分句①】University tuition fees (学费) 是主语，are currently capped 为被动谓语，at £3,000 表示学费上限，annually 表示每年。
【并列分句②】but this will be reviewed next year：this 是主语，指前文收费上限，will be reviewed 为被动谓语，next year 为时间状语。

【并列分句③】and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling：the Government 为主语，is 为系动词，under enormous pressure 为介词短语作表语；to raise the ceiling 为不定式后置修饰 pressure，交代压力要求的行动；the ceiling 指费用上限。
【易错点】三组主语分别是 tuition fees / this / the Government。but 和 and 连接的是三个分句，不能误判为相同主语的并列谓语；这里没有主句的直接宾语。

roleExplanations.s: 第一分句的完整主语 University tuition fees (学费)；tuition 与 University 均修饰核心 fees。
roleExplanations.v: 第一分句 are currently capped 为被动谓语，currently 是时间副词；at £3,000 annually 说明上限金额及年计口径。

grammarSupplements.kind: 第一分句·金额与频率状语
grammarSupplements.text: at £3,000 annually,
grammarSupplements.explanation: at £3,000 表示学费最高金额，annually 为‘每年’的频率状语。第一分句主语 University tuition fees，谓语 are currently capped。

grammarSupplements.text: but this will be reviewed next year
grammarSupplements.explanation: 第二分句的主语 this 指学费上限，will be reviewed 是被动谓语，next year 是时间状语。这里不是 fees 的并列谓语。

grammarSupplements.text: and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 第三分句主语 the Government，系动词 is，under enormous pressure 为表语；to raise the ceiling 修饰 pressure，说明所承受压力的具体内容。三个并列分句各有自己的主语。

studyUnits.kind: 第一分句·金额与频率状语

studyUnits.text: at £3,000 annually,
studyUnits.explanation: at £3,000 表示学费最高金额，annually 为‘每年’的频率状语。第一分句主语 University tuition fees，谓语 are currently capped。

studyUnits.explanation: 第二分句的主语 this 指学费上限，will be reviewed 是被动谓语，next year 是时间状语。这里不是 fees 的并列谓语。

studyUnits.question: and 引出了哪个完整的第三分句？
studyUnits.text: and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.
studyUnits.explanation: 第三分句主语 the Government，系动词 is，under enormous pressure 为表语；to raise the ceiling 修饰 pressure，说明所承受压力的具体内容。三个并列分句各有自己的主语。

sentences.sentence: In the research, the teenagers were presented with the terms of four different loans but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest.
sentences.main: The teenagers were presented with loan terms, but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest.
sentences.analysis:
【前置状语】In the research 为介词短语作范围/背景状语，说明研究场景。
【并列分句①】the teenagers（主语）+ were presented（被动谓语）+ with the terms of four different loans（介词补足语）；意思是向青少年提供四种贷款条款。of four different loans 修饰 terms。
【并列分句②】but 76 per cent（主语，意指研究中的76%青少年）+ failed（谓语）+ to identify the cheapest（不定式补足语）；the cheapest 是省略 loan 的名词化最高级，作 identify 的宾语。
【易错】but 后是不同主语的新分句，不是 teenagers 的第二个共用主语谓语；前句的 with ... 也不是额外的主句直接宾语。
sentences.meaning: 研究中，青少年看到四种不同贷款的条款，但其中76%的人没能找出最便宜的一种。
distractors: 研究向青少年介绍四种不同的贷款方案，其中76%的人成功找出了费用最低的一种。
研究显示，76%的青少年无法在四种贷款中找出利率最高的那一种。
研究发现，青少年只获得一种贷款方案的条款，因此无法比较四种贷款的成本。
deepNotes: 【前置状语】In the research 为介词短语作范围/背景状语，说明研究场景。
【并列分句①】the teenagers（主语）+ were presented（被动谓语）+ with the terms of four different loans（介词补足语）；意思是向青少年提供四种贷款条款。of four different loans 修饰 terms。
【并列分句②】but 76 per cent（主语，意指研究中的76%青少年）+ failed（谓语）+ to identify the cheapest（不定式补足语）；the cheapest 是省略 loan 的名词化最高级，作 identify 的宾语。
【易错】but 后是不同主语的新分句，不是 teenagers 的第二个共用主语谓语；前句的 with ... 也不是额外的主句直接宾语。

roleExplanations.s: 第一分句主语 the teenagers，指参与研究的青少年。
roleExplanations.v: were presented 是被动谓语，主动逻辑相当于研究人员向青少年提供了贷款条款。

grammarSupplements.text: In the research,
grammarSupplements.explanation: In the research 是背景状语；第一分句主语 the teenagers，were presented 是被动谓语。

grammarSupplements.text: with the terms of four different loans
grammarSupplements.explanation: be presented with 表示‘被出示／获提供’，with ... 补充呈现的内容；of four different loans 在这个名词短语里修饰 terms。

grammarSupplements.text: but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 第二分句主语 76 per cent，谓语 failed；to identify the cheapest 是不定式补足语，其中 the cheapest 省略了 loan。

studyUnits.question: 句首哪一段交代研究发生的背景？
studyUnits.text: In the research,
studyUnits.explanation: In the research 是背景状语；第一分句主语 the teenagers，were presented 是被动谓语。

studyUnits.text: but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest.
studyUnits.explanation: 第二分句主语 76 per cent，谓语 failed；to identify the cheapest 是不定式补足语，其中 the cheapest 省略了 loan。

sentences.sentence: The young people also predicted that they would be earning on average £31,000 by the age of 25, although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815.

targets.o: that they would be earning on average £31,000 by the age of 25,
targets.x: although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815.

sentences.main: The young people predicted that they would be earning £31,000, although the average salary is just £17,815.
sentences.analysis:
【主句】The young people 是主语，also 为副词作状语，predicted 为谓语，that ... by the age of 25 为宾语从句。
【宾语从句】they 是主语，would be earning 是过去视角的将来进行时谓语；£31,000 表示预计年收入金额，on average 表示平均水平，by the age of 25 是时间状语。
【让步状语从句】although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815 与年轻人的预计作对照；主语 the average salary for those aged 22 to 29，系动词 is，表语 just £17,815；for those aged 22 to 29 修饰 salary，aged 22 to 29 修饰 those。
【易错】although 从句有自己的主系表结构；主句没有并列谓语。
sentences.meaning: 这些年轻人预测到25岁时平均收入可达31,000英镑，但22至29岁人群实际平均薪资仅17,815英镑。
distractors: 年轻人估计自己25岁时年收入只有17,815英镑，而22至29岁人群实际平均工资达到31,000英镑。
年轻人预计22岁时就能平均赚到31,000英镑，而25岁人群的实际年薪只有17,815英镑。
年轻人预测自己的年收入为31,000英镑，而22至29岁人群的实际平均年收入也完全符合这一预测。
deepNotes: 【主句】The young people 是主语，also 为副词作状语，predicted 为谓语，that ... by the age of 25 为宾语从句。
【宾语从句】they 是主语，would be earning 是过去视角的将来进行时谓语；£31,000 表示预计年收入金额，on average 表示平均水平，by the age of 25 是时间状语。

【让步状语从句】although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815 与年轻人的预计作对照；主语 the average salary for those aged 22 to 29，系动词 is，表语 just £17,815；for those aged 22 to 29 修饰 salary，aged 22 to 29 修饰 those。
【易错】although 从句有自己的主系表结构；主句没有并列谓语。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语 The young people，指受访青年。

sentences.sentence: Stephen Moir, head of community investment at the Royal Bank of Scotland Group which owns NatWest, said, "The more exposed young people are to financial issues, and the younger they become aware of them, the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults who manage their finances confidently and effectively."
sentences.analysis:
【外层主句】Stephen Moir 是主语；said 是谓语；其后整段引号内的话是直接引语，作为 said 说出的内容。
【同位语与定语】head of community investment at the Royal Bank of Scotland Group which owns NatWest 是人物身份同位语，说明 Stephen Moir 的职位；which owns NatWest 定语从句修饰 Royal Bank of Scotland Group，该从句主语 which、谓语 owns、宾语 NatWest。
【直接引语的关联比较】两个程度条件形成一个结论：The more exposed young people are to financial issues（青少年接触金融问题越多）；and the younger they become aware of them（越早意识到）；the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults ...（就越可能成长为负责且有规划的成年人）。它们并非外层 Stephen Moir 的并列谓语。
【引语内部】第一比较分句的主语 young people、系动词 are、前置表语 more exposed；第二分句的主语 they、系动词 become、表语 aware，the younger 表示认知发生得更早；结果分句主语 they、系动词 are、表语 more likely，to become ... 为补足语。
【嵌套定语从句】who manage their finances confidently and effectively 修饰 adults；其主语 who、谓语 manage、宾语 their finances，confidently and effectively 为并列方式状语。
sentences.meaning: 苏格兰皇家银行集团社区投资主管斯蒂芬·莫伊尔说：“年轻人接触金融问题越多、越早了解这些问题，就越可能成长为负责任且善于规划、自信而有效地管理自己财务的成年人。”
distractors: 莫伊尔认为，年轻人越晚接触金融知识，就越能自信而有效地管理个人财务。
莫伊尔指出，越早接触金融问题，年轻人未来就越可能陷入严重债务并失去规划能力。
苏格兰皇家银行集团负责人表示，年轻人无须了解金融问题，也能自然成长为善于理财的成年人。
deepNotes: 【外层主句】Stephen Moir 是主语；said 是谓语；其后整段引号内的话是直接引语，作为 said 说出的内容。

sentences.main: Ministers are deeply concerned about the financial pressures.
sentences.analysis:
【主句主干】Ministers（主语）+ are（系动词）+ deeply concerned（表语），构成主系表；deeply 是程度副词修饰 concerned。
【表语的补足成分】about the financial pressures on teenagers and young people 指明担忧的对象，属于 concerned 后的介词补足语。
【定语】on teenagers and young people 是介词短语修饰 pressures，说明压力施加于哪些人。
【原因】because of student loans and rising housing costs 表示压力来源，也解释部长们担忧的原因；because of 后接名词短语，不是引导完整原因状语从句。

sentences.main: They have just introduced new lessons.
sentences.analysis:
【主句】They 为主语，回指上句政府官员；have introduced 是现在完成时的谓语框架，just 插在助动词与过去分词之间作时间副词，have just introduced 整体表示‘刚刚推出’。
【宾语】new lessons in how to manage debts 是完整宾语，中心词 lessons，new 前置修饰它；只选 new lessons 作为宾语中心名词短语也可以判对。
【后置定语】in how to manage debts 是介词短语修饰 lessons，说明课程的内容；介词 in 后的 how to manage debts 是疑问词 how + 不定式构成的结构（如何管理债务），manage 的宾语为 debts。
【不要误判】in how ... 不属于独立主句状语，也没有新的有限谓语或独立从句。

【不要误判】in how ... 不属于独立主句状语，也没有新的有限谓语或独立从句。

roleExplanations.s: They 是主语，指前文相关政府人员。
roleExplanations.v: have just introduced 是主句完成时谓语，just 为时间副词，表示刚刚。
roleExplanations.o: 完整宾语 new lessons in how to manage debts；中心名词短语 new lessons 也有效。后面 in ... 为修饰 lessons 的内容定语。

sentences.sentence: Nikki Fairweather, aged 15 from St Helens, said that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance, but admitted that she still had a lot to learn about money.

targets.o: that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance,
targets.o2: that she still had a lot to learn about money.

sentences.analysis:
【主句】Nikki Fairweather 为共同主语；said（谓语①）和 admitted（谓语②）由 but 连接，是同一主语的并列谓语，不是两个不同主语的独立分句；每个谓语各支配自己的 that 宾语从句。
【主语补充】aged 15 from St Helens 后置补充 Nikki 的年龄与来自哪里；aged 15 表年龄的过去分词短语，from St Helens 表来源，不能误认为谓语。
【宾语从句①】that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance：she 为主语，had benefited 是过去完成时谓语，from lessons on personal finance 为动词 benefited 的介词补足语；on personal finance 修饰 lessons，说明理财课程主题。
【宾语从句②】that she still had a lot to learn about money：she 为主语，had 为谓语，a lot to learn about money 为宾语；still 为副词状语，to learn about money 是不定式作后置定语修饰 a lot，about money 补充 learn 所涉及的内容。
【易错】said 与 admitted 都由 Nikki 发出，不能把 she had benefited 或 she still had 误认成主句的并列谓语；but 不连接两个 that 宾语从句，而是连接两组‘谓语 + 宾语从句’。
sentences.meaning: 来自圣海伦斯的15岁女孩妮基·费尔韦瑟说，个人理财课使她受益，但也承认自己在金钱方面还有很多需要学习。

妮基表示自己虽然上过个人理财课，但已经完全掌握金钱知识，不再需要进一步学习。

roleExplanations.s: Nikki Fairweather 是两个并列主句谓语 said 和 admitted 共用的主语；aged 15 from St Helens 是主语后的年龄、籍贯补充修饰。
roleExplanations.v: said 是谓语①，后接第一 that 宾语从句。
roleExplanations.o: that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance 是 said 的宾语从句，内部 she 为主语、had benefited 为谓语。
roleExplanations.v2: admitted 是并列谓语②，与 said 共用 Nikki 这个主语，but 表转折。
roleExplanations.o2: that she still had a lot to learn about money 是 admitted 的宾语从句，内部 she still had a lot to learn ...。

review.theme: 英国青少年金融知识不足与及早加强理财教育
review.overview: NatWest调查8500名青少年发现他们缺乏金融知识，高估收入、低估负债，贷款判断能力不强。学费及住房成本带来压力，专家与政府希望通过早期金融教育改善情况。

paragraphNotes.point: 8500名青少年不懂金钱问题，未来债务风险令人担忧。
学费有年度上限，政府面临提高限额的压力。
paragraphNotes.connection: 第73题 ceiling 指学费上限。

paragraphNotes.point: 贷款条款辨识差，高估未来收入、低估实际债务。
Stephen Moir强调越早学习理财知识越能有效管理财务。
政府推出相关课程，青少年虽受益仍有更多学习空间。
paragraphNotes.connection: 对应全文解决方案，不应误解为大学必修课。

development: 第1段：研究发现多数学青少年缺乏钱的知识。
第2段：学费政策与上限的潜在调整。
第3段：贷款、收入、债务数据证据。
第4段：专家主张及早接触金融知识。
第5段：政府与学生对理财教育的回应。
keyGrammar: involving 8,500 teenagers：现在分词后置修饰 study。
findings, the first ... NatWest that has started ..., are ...：同位语插入语中带定语从句，真正谓语是 are。
fees are capped ..., but this will be reviewed ..., and the Government is ...：三组独立主谓，不能套用共享主语。
predicted that ... although ...：宾语从句 + 让步状语从句。
said that they assumed the debts would ...：多层宾语从句。
The more ... the more ...：越……越……比较关联；who manage ... 修饰 adults。
Nikki said that ..., but admitted that ...：两个共享主语的并列谓语、各带宾语从句。
keyPhrases: ignorant when it comes to money：谈到金钱问题就缺乏相关知识
be burdened with debts：背负债务
tuition fees / cap at：学费／限定上限
be exposed to financial issues：接触财务问题
commonMistakes: 72：预估£31,000而实际均薪£17,815，不要颠倒数据。
73：raise the ceiling 意为提高上限，非提高天花板。
74：Stephen Moir主张尽早学习财务知识，非太年轻不应了解。
75：当前大多数人金融知识不足，不能误说已经背负沉重债务。

questionSets.title: 2008年上海秋考英语 · 阅读C · 原卷72—75题
questionSets.source: 2008年上海秋考英语卷 · 阅读C · 原卷题图、参考答案交叉核对
questionSets.intro: 原卷4道阅读理解题。先独立答题，再提交查看原文依据和解析。
questionSets.passageText:
A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds found that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money. The findings, the first in a series of reports from NatWest that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money, are particularly worrying as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before.

University tuition fees (学费) are currently capped at £3,000 annually, but this will be reviewed next year and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.

In the research, the teenagers were presented with the terms of four different loans but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest. The young people also predicted that they would be earning on average £31,000 by the age of 25, although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815. The teenagers expected to be in debt when they finished university or training, although half said that they assumed the debts would be less than £10,000. Average debts for graduates are £12,363.

Stephen Moir, head of community investment at the Royal Bank of Scotland Group which owns NatWest, said, "The more exposed young people are to financial issues, and the younger they become aware of them, the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults who manage their finances confidently and effectively."

Ministers are deeply concerned about the financial pressures on teenagers and young people because of student loans and rising housing costs. They have just introduced new lessons in how to manage debts. Nikki Fairweather, aged 15 from St Helens, said that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance, but admitted that she still had a lot to learn about money.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be found from the five-year research project?
options: University tuition fees in England have been rising.
Teenagers tend to overestimate their future earnings.
The students' payback ability has become a major issue.
questions.evidence: The young people also predicted that they would be earning on average £31,000 by the age of 25, although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815.
questions.explanation: 青少年预期收入£31,000，现实平均收入只有£17,815，说明高估未来收入。B项错误地把可能提高学费上限当作已经持续上涨，选C。

questions.stem: The phrase "to raise the ceiling" in paragraph 2 probably means "_______".
options: to increase the upper limit of the tuition
to lift the school building roofs
questions.evidence: University tuition fees (学费) are currently capped at £3,000 annually, but this will be reviewed next year and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.
questions.explanation: capped at £3,000 annually 表示学费有最高限额，因此 raise the ceiling 是提高学费上限，不是提高屋顶，选C。

options: are too young to be exposed to financial issues
should learn to manage their finances well
should maintain a positive attitude when facing loans
benefit a lot from lessons on personal finance
questions.evidence: The more exposed young people are to financial issues, and the younger they become aware of them, the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults who manage their finances confidently and effectively.
questions.explanation: Stephen Moir 认为年轻人应尽早接触理财知识，以便有效管理财务，选B。D是Nikki的个人经历。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
options: Many British teenagers do not know money matters well
Teenagers in Britain are heavily burdened with debts.
Financial planning is a required course at college.
Young people should become responsible adults.
questions.evidence: A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds found that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money.
questions.explanation: 调查发现大多数英国青少年缺乏金钱知识，后文贷款、收入及债务数据进一步证实，选A。B混淆当前与未来，C把新开课程误作大学必修。
